title: RAISIN CAKE
instructions: --One cup butter, three eggs, one and one-half cups sugar, one cup sour milk, one teaspoon soda, one cup raisins, little nutmeg, three cups flour.  One can use two eggs and one-half cup butter; then bake as usual.
